schemes.unresolved: Programmes in which the module can be taken, and credit value, not confirmed from the extract.

profile_md:
Newcastle's verified provision is distributed across schools rather than institution-wide. The strongest cluster is in the Business School: BUS3053 (final-year undergraduate Management Consultancy Project, 40 places, group report and presentation to an external client, 2025/26 page), MKT3097 (marketing equivalent, current delivery not corroborated beyond 2024/25), the MBA team module NBS8130 (client-set briefs, 2025/26 regulations) and the Business in Action case competition run with Northumbrian Water (latest dated 2024, about a week).

Outside business, TCP8024 (planning, compulsory on the MPlan) puts student groups on a live brief set by an outside client; APL3001 has groups design and build an intervention with a community group; POL3103 places up to 20 students in research teams for partner (voluntary-sector) organisations, though its assessment is now mostly individual portfolio. NES2202 Sustainable Solutions is a compulsory-in-programme sponsor-set team challenge in Natural and Environmental Sciences, but its currency is undated. In computing, the compulsory Stage 2 CSC2033 team project involves industry sponsors/employer feedback, but the module page says this varies by year, so employer involvement is Unclear. Mechanical Engineering describes company-hosted final-year team projects (undated page).

Centrally, the Careers Service ran a three-week Practera Horizons consulting programme in January 2026 (12 funded places; real start-up/business/charity briefs), but eligibility and client engagement depth are not documented. Enterprise provision (NCL2100, START UP) was not shown to involve live clients.

Uncertain: current-year evidence for several routes, partner names, and engineering/science departmental instances.
gaps: Further departmental capstones likely (Civil, Chemical, Electrical engineering; Biosciences, Chemistry, Physics; Education, Sociology, Modern Languages, Digital Civics/Open Lab; Dentistry/Medicine/Nursing). Not tested: SPG8500, EIN2011/EIN3000/BMS3003 enterprise modules (group business-idea assignments likely hypothetical), CSC8-coded MSc team projects, Newcastle Think Tank/student consultancy societies, Social Justice North East current partners. Current-year evidence missing for MKT3097, NES2202, Mechanical Engineering projects, Business in Action, Data Science and Industrial Biotechnology, Museum Studies. All evidence is search-index extract/paraphrase; no pages opened.
